topography.project_purpose: Token Locker. Structurally: 133 project-authored contract(s) across 8 chain(s); 26 ERC20 tokens, 5 ERC721 NFTs, 2 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 30 common project-authored base contract(s) (bep20, erc165, upgradeableproxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
